steps.title: Extrude the box
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as mitre_post.ipt.
Sketch on the XZ Plane: rectangle 700 x 450 with its left edge on the origin. Extrude 5910 mm up.
steps.note: The post is drawn 700 long; the end is trimmed to the mitre angle later.

steps.title: Make it hollow
actions: Sketch on a work plane 5935 mm up: rectangle 25 mm in from the left, front and back faces, ending 490 mm from the left end. Extrude Cut 5860 mm down.
steps.note: The ends and the mitre end stay solid.

steps.title: Trim the mitre
actions: Work Features panel > Plane > Angle to Plane around Edge: the vertical line 300 mm along X on the leaf centre line, 18.43 degrees (1 in 3) to the end face.
Click Split, Trim Solid, and remove the end beyond the plane. Save.
steps.note: The water pushes the two mitre faces together, so the gates seal harder the higher the water.
